comments.value: This would seperate friends so i dont understand why they would allow blocking of groups at all.

@{6015a8dedd548068697b6112|full_name} I'm not sure what you mean by separating friends. Just about any player moderation action that already exists has way more potential to "separate friends" either directly or via social discourse than this minor addition would.

Players can already block each other, kick people from instances, and groups can already preemtively ban specific users which bars them from being able to join any instance of that group in the first place. These things are a much bigger issue for separating friends if that's what you're concerned about.

But VRC has already implemented those things, so we already exist in a player-moderated environment. This addition really just gives you more power as a player to remove content you don't like from your personal universe so to speak.

I think the ability to block and moderate your space is important. Any social issues that arise from it have to be dealt with in a social fashion. Friends caught in a crossfire between two people have conversations they need to have and choices they have to make, just like they would in real life. Not allowing people to block/ban/kick each other would only make for more unhinged situations, and provide no way for dealing with actually problematic people.

I proposed this idea because there are certain groups I am banned from or disliked by, and I really rather just not see the group around anymore and especially not see their instances in my social menu.

But if group blocking doesn't do anything and isn't going to do anything in the future then there's no need to even pretend that it's a feature and the group block button on the website should just be removed and group invite ignores should be treated as ignores same as ignored friend requests.

details:
Kinda related to another recent post of mine: https://feedback.vrchat.com/website/p/website-you-cannot-block-groups-that-have-banned-you

Honestly, the current system for group blocking is hardly "blocking" anything, it's more of just an "ignore future invites from this group" button.

I think if you're gonna keep a blocking system for this at all, it should do more. Hide their instances, censor the name and image for the group, etc.

Otherwise, it's really just the same as clicking the ignore button on a friend request, isn't it? And in that case, why not just call it an ignored group invite and sort ignored group invites in the inbox where ignored friend requests are? (Maybe in their own category though).

So yeah, my suggestion is to either make group blocking do something more than just ignore invites, or just sort it in it's own category on the same page as ignored friend requests on the website and remove the block button from groups as it doesn't really do anything.

Thanks.
title: Group blocking should either do more than just ignore invites, or it should be named something else and handled differently.
